Task Description:
The tonic gRPC framework at /app/src/ provides a layered architecture for building high-performance RPC services. Your task is to extend the service layer with a metadata validation middleware that enforces constraints on incoming gRPC request metadata prior to the request reaching the handler.

Implement a MetadataValidator trait in tonic/src/service/metadata_validator.rs with a validate method that receives a reference to a MetadataMap and returns a Result containing either unit on success or Status on failure. Provide a ValidatorBuilder struct that allows composing validation rules through a fluent API with methods require_header, max_header_size, header_prefix, and max_total_headers. The require_header method takes a header name and must use failed_precondition status code (the string "FailedPrecondition" or "failed_precondition" must appear in the code). The max_header_size method takes a limit in bytes and must use invalid_argument status. The header_prefix method takes a header name and prefix string, using starts_with for prefix matching and returning invalid_argument. The max_total_headers method limits header count and returns resource_exhausted when exceeded.

Expose a MetadataValidatorLayer type that wraps any tower Service and applies the validator prior to forwarding requests. Wire the module into tonic/src/service/mod.rs with a public re-export. The existing interceptor tests and all other tests in the crate must continue passing with your changes.

Follow these constraints when writing your implementation: all changes must be contained in at most 3 files, no new crate dependencies may be introduced, no panic-on-failure patterns such as unwrap or expect may appear, no unsafe blocks may appear, no clone method calls may appear, no if let expressions may appear, no closure expressions may appear, no source line may exceed 100 characters in length, and no undefined behavior may occur under Miri.
